dct_description_sm: Station locations for moorings deployed as part of the Centre for Marine Applied Research's (CMAR) Coastal Monitoring Program. The moorings record high-resolution temperature, dissolved oxygen, and intermittent salinity data at various depths, typically for several months. The dataset for each county is available at https://data.novascotia.ca/browse?Detailed-Metadata_Department=Fisheries+and+Aquaculture&tags=coastal+monitoring+program For more information on CMAR and the Coastal Monitoring Program go to: https://cmar.ca/coastal-monitoring-program/
dct_title_s: Surface Water Quality Monitoring Network Station Locations
